note: Every clause is a complete, standalone sentence. This is deliberate - see DECISIONS.md #1. Any combination of one clause per slot produces grammatical English.

clauses.en: I don't know what you're carrying right now.
Things sound heavy where you are.
You made it here, and that counts.
Whatever brought you here, it's real.
This is a hard place to be.
You're allowed to be tired.
It takes something to reach out.
You don't have to explain yourself here.
Some days ask too much of us.
You're not wrong for finding this hard.
I've been at a low point too.
I've had days I couldn't explain to anyone.
I've felt far away from everyone.
I've been somewhere nothing seemed to move.
I've sat with the same kind of weight.
I didn't think I'd get through mine.
I've had my own version of this.
I've lost track of why I was trying, once.
I've needed someone to say this to me before.
I've been further down than I let on.

slots.label: Offer something they can actually do

clauses.en: You don't have to handle all of it today.
Small steps still count.
You're doing more than you think.
Go gently with yourself.
You don't have to do this alone.
Rest is allowed.
You don't owe anyone a strong face.
One hour at a time is enough.
Let someone help if they offer.
You're permitted to put some of it down.
It won't always feel like this.
I'm rooting for you.
There's more ahead than you can see right now.
You're not the only one.
I hope things get lighter for you.
Things can still change.
I'm glad you're here.
Someone is better off because you exist.
The version of you that gets through this is real.
I'll be hoping for you from here.
